evidence.pali: ‘‘‘Cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati ; ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “学：‘我将觉知心而出息’；学：‘我将觉知心而入息’。学：‘我将令心喜悦而出息’；学：‘我将令心喜悦而入息’。学：‘我将令心入定而出息’；学：‘我将令心入定而入息’。学：‘我将令心解脱而出息’；学：‘我将令心解脱而入息’。”
evidence.english: He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mind, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Gladdening the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Gladdening the mind, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Concentrating the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Concentrating the mind, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Liberating the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Liberating the mind, I will breathe in.’

entries.pali: Sīgha nti ettha samāpajjitukāmatānantaraṃ dvīsu bhavaṅgesu uppannesu bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā uppannāvajjanānantaraṃ samāpajjanaṃ sīghaṃ samāpajjanasamatthatā . Ayañca matthakappattā samāpajjanavasī satthu dhammadesanāyaṃ labbhati. Yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tassā eva kathāya pariyosāne tasmiṃyeva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi yenassudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.387). Ito sīghatarā hi samāpajjanavasī nāma natthi. Juṇhāya rattiyā navoropitehi kesehi kapotakandarāyaṃ viharantassa āyasmato sāriputtassa yakkhena mahantampi pabbatakūṭaṃ padāletuṃ samatthe pahāre sīse dinne samāpajjanampettha nidassetabbaṃ. Tathā hi vakkhati ‘‘tadā thero tassa paharaṇasamaye samāpattiṃ appesī’’ti (visuddhi. 2.374). Pāḷiyaṃ pana ‘‘aññataraṃ samādhiṃ samāpajjitvā nisinno’’ti (udā. 34) vuttaṃ. Ime pana therā ‘‘samāpattito vuṭṭhānasamakālaṃ tena pahāro dinno’’ti vadanti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 此中的‘迅速’，是指在欲入定之心生起后，两个有分心生起，截断有分心，生起转向，紧接着便能入定，此即迅速入定的能力。这种已达顶峰的入定自在，见于世尊的教法中。就此而有言：“阿耆毗舍那（Aggivessana），我在那教法结束时，就在那先前的定相上，于内安住、平息、专注、统一其心，我恒常安住于此。”（《中部》1.387）实无有比此更迅速的入定自在。又如具寿舍利弗，于月夜新剃发后，住在鸽子洞（Kapotakandarā）时，被一位夜叉（yakkha）以能劈裂大山顶之力击其头，于此亦当显示其入定。诚然，如《清净道论》将言：“当时长老于被击打之时，进入等至。”（《清净道论》2.374）但在巴利圣典中则说：“进入某一禅定而坐。”（《自说经》34）而这些长老们说：“那一击是与他出等至同时发生的。”
entries.english: Here, 'swiftly' (`sīghaṃ`) refers to the ability to swiftly enter absorption, which occurs immediately after the desire to enter arises, after two bhavaṅga moments have arisen, the bhavaṅga has been cut off, and immediately after the adverting has arisen. And this mastery in entering absorption, having reached its pinnacle, is found in the Teacher's discourse. This is what is meant by the statement: 'At the end of that very talk, Aggivessana, I internally steadied my mind on that very same former sign of concentration, settled it, unified it, and concentrated it, by which I dwell, as it were, constantly.' (MN 36). Indeed, there is no mastery in entering absorption swifter than this. For example, when the venerable Sāriputta was dwelling in the Pigeon’s Grotto during a moonlit night with freshly shaven hair, a yakkha struck his head with a blow powerful enough to split even a great mountain peak; the entering of absorption should be shown as an example here. For it will be said: 'At that time, at the moment of the blow, the elder entered into attainment.' (Vism. XII.74). In the Pāḷi Canon, however, it is stated: 'Having entered a certain concentration, he was seated.' (Ud. 4.4). But these elders say: 'The blow was delivered at the very moment of his emerging from the attainment.'

entries.pali: Cittekaggatāmatto ti bhāvanamanuyuttena paṭiladdhamattaṃ nātisubhāvitaṃ samādhānaṃ. Taṃ pana upari vuccamānānaṃ samādhivisesānaṃ mūlakāraṇabhāvato ‘‘mūlasamādhī’’ ti vutto. Svāyaṃ cittekaggatāmatto ‘‘ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmī’’tiādīsu viya khaṇikasamādhi adhippeto. Yatheva hi aññatthāpi ‘‘āraddhaṃ kho pana me, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ…pe… samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagga’’nti (a. ni. 8.11; pārā. 11) vatvā ‘‘vivicceva kāmehī’’tiādivacanato (a. ni. 8.11) paṭhamaṃ vuttacittekaggatā ‘‘khaṇikasamādhī’’ti viññāyati, evamidhāpīti. So eva samādhī ti mūlasamādhimāha.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘仅是心一境性’(cittekaggatāmatto)，是指致力于修行者所获得的、尚未善加培育的定。然而，此定是之后将述说的诸殊胜定的根本原因，故被称为‘根本定’(mūlasamādhi)。此仅是心一境性，如在“我于内安住心，令其寂静，作成一趣，令其等持”等句中，意指刹那定。诚然，正如在别处，佛陀说了“诸比丘，我已发起精进，不退屈……心已等持、专一”后，又因说到“远离诸欲”等，可知最初所说的心一境性为‘刹那定’；于此经中，亦应如是了知。‘彼即是定’(so eva samādhi)一句，乃指根本定。
entries.english: “Merely one-pointedness of mind” (cittekaggatāmatto) is a concentration that is merely attained by one devoted to development, a concentration not yet very well developed. That, however, being the root cause of the special concentrations to be mentioned later, is called “root concentration.” This mere one-pointedness of mind is intended as momentary concentration, as in passages such as “‘I establish my mind internally, quiet it, make it unified, concentrate it.’” For just as elsewhere, after saying, “My energy, O monks, was roused, unflagging… my mind was concentrated, one-pointed” (A.N. 8.11; Pārā. 11), the one-pointedness of mind mentioned first is understood as “momentary concentration” because of the statement, “Secluded from sensual pleasures,” and so forth (A.N. 8.11), so too is it understood here. By “that very concentration,” he refers to the root concentration.

entries.pali: Atha dutiyo vuttanayeneva āgantvā abhāsi. Tattha tatra bhikkhavo ti tasmiṃ sannipātaṭṭhāne bhikkhū. Samādahaṃsū ti samādhinā yojesuṃ. Cittamattano ujukaṃ akaṃsū ti attano cittaṃ sabbe vaṅkakuṭilajimhabhāve haritvā ujukaṃ akariṃsu. Sārathīva nettāni gahetvā ti yathā samappavattesu sindhavesu odhastapatodo sārathi sabbayottāni gahetvā acodento avārento tiṭṭhati, evaṃ chaḷaṅgupekkhāsamannāgatā guttadvārā sabbepete pañcasatā bhikkhū indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā, ete daṭṭhuṃ idhāgatamha bhagavāti. Sopi gantvā yathāṭhāneyeva aṭṭhāsi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 其后，第二位（梵天）也以同样的方式前来说道。于此，‘彼处诸比丘’（tatra bhikkhavo）意指在那个集会处的诸比丘。‘他们专注’（samādahaṃsu）意指他们以定力使心相应。‘他们使自己的心正直’（cittamattano ujukaṃ akaṃsu）意指他们去除自己心中所有的弯曲、歪斜与虚伪，使之正直。‘如同御者执持缰绳’（sārathīva nettāni gahetvā）意指：就像在信度（Sindhu）良马平稳奔驰时，御者放下鞭子，仅执持所有缰绳，不驱策也不制止地站立着；同样地，这五百位比丘具足六支舍，守护根门，是贤智者，守护着诸根。‘世尊，我们是为了见到他们而来此。’（ete daṭṭhuṃ idhāgatamha bhagavā'ti）说完，他也去到自己原来的位置站立。
entries.english: Then the second Brahmā came in the manner described and spoke. Therein, 'the bhikkhus there' (tatra bhikkhavo) refers to the bhikkhus in that place of assembly. 'Composed themselves' (samādahaṃsu) means they yoked their minds with concentration. 'They made their own minds straight' (cittamattano ujukaṃ akaṃsu) means they all removed any state of crookedness, perversity, or deviousness from their minds and made them straight. 'Like a charioteer holding the reins' (sārathīva nettāni gahetvā): just as a charioteer, with goad laid down, holds all the reins while his thoroughbreds proceed evenly, neither urging them on nor holding them back, so too do these five hundred bhikkhus—wise, with guarded sense-doors, and endowed with six-factored equanimity—guard their faculties. The meaning is: 'O Blessed One, we have come here to see them.' He too went and stood in his proper place.

entries.pali: Samādahaṃsū ti samādahitaṃ lokuttarasamādhinā suṭṭhu appitaṃ akaṃsu, yathāsamāhitaṃ pana samādhinā yojitaṃ nāma hotīti vuttaṃ ‘‘samādhinā yojesu’’ nti. Sabbesaṃ gomuttavaṅkādīnaṃ dūrasamūhanitattā sabbe…pe… akariṃsu. Nayati asse etehīti nettāni, yottāni. Avīthipaṭipannānaṃ assānaṃ vīthipaṭipādanaṃ rasmiggahaṇena pahotīti ‘‘sabbayottāni gahetvā acodento’’ti vatvā taṃ pana acodanaṃ avāraṇaṃ evāti āha ‘‘acodento avārento’’ ti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 所谓‘使心安定’，即是以出世间定善加安止，犹如以定调御，故说‘以定调御之’。因远离了一切如牛尿般的弯曲等，他们使一切心念……乃至……正直。‘用此引导马’，故为引导具(nettāni)，即缰绳(yottāni)。对于未入正道的马，通过执持缰绳即能使其走上正道，故说‘执持所有缰绳而不驱策’，而此不驱策即是不妨碍，故说‘不驱策，不妨碍’。
entries.english: "They concentrated" (samādahaṃsu) means they made their minds well-applied with supramundane concentration. But because that which is well-concentrated is indeed conjoined by concentration, it is said, "they yoked by concentration" (samādhinā yojesuṃ). Because all crooked things like the path of cow's urine were removed far away, they made all... "Those by which one leads horses" (nayati asse etehi) are reins (nettāni), or tethers (yottāni). Since guiding horses that are not following the course onto the course is possible by grasping the reins, having said, "taking all the tethers without urging," he then says that this non-urging is simply non-hindrance, hence "without urging, without hindering."

entries.pali: Avisesenā ti na visesena, vihārabhāvasāmaññenāti attho. Iriyāpatha…pe… vihāresū ti iriyāpathavihāro dibbavihāro brahmavihāro ariyavihāroti etesu catūsu vihāresu. Samaṅgiparidīpana nti samaṅgībhāvaparidīpanaṃ. Eta nti ‘‘viharatī’’ti etaṃ padaṃ. Tathā hi taṃ ‘‘idhekacco gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī’’tiādīsu (saṃ. ni. 4.241) iriyāpathavihāre āgataṃ; ‘‘yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī’’tiādīsu (dha. sa. 160; vibha. 624) dibbavihāre; ‘‘so mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatī’’tiādīsu (dī. ni. 1.556; 3.308; ma. ni. 1.77; 2.309; 3.230) brahmavihāre; ‘‘so kho ahaṃ aggivessana tassāyeva kathāya pariyosāne tasmiṃ eva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi, yena sudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmī’’tiādīsu (ma. ni. 1.387) ariyavihāre.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘不加区别’(Avisesena)意为‘不作特定指称’，即就‘住’的一般状态而言。行住坐卧等……在诸住中，即指四种住：威仪住、天住、梵住、圣住。“具足明示”即是显示具足状态。“此”指的是“住”这个词。例如，“于此，某人与在家人交往而住，同喜同悲”等（《相应部》4.241）说的是威仪住；“诸比丘，比丘完全离开诸欲……证得并安住于初禅”等（《法集论》160；《分别论》624）说的是天住；“他以与慈俱之心遍满一方而安住”等（《长部》1.556；3.308；《中部》1.77；2.309；3.230）说的是梵住；“阿耆毗舍那(Aggivessana)，我正是在那场说法结束时，就在先前那个三摩地相上，于内令心安定、安住、专一、等持，借此而恒常安住”等（《中部》1.387）说的是圣住。
entries.english: Not by a distinction: that is, not in a special way; the meaning is by the commonality of the state of dwelling. Postures... in dwellings: in these four dwellings, namely, the dwelling of posture, the divine dwelling, the brahma-dwelling, and the noble dwelling. The explanation of being endowed: this is the explanation of the state of being endowed. This: this is the word 'dwells.' For it is found in the dwelling of posture in such passages as: 'Here, some person dwells associating with householders, sharing their joys and sorrows'; in the divine dwelling in such passages as: 'At the time, bhikkhus, when a bhikkhu, secluded from sensual pleasures... having entered the first jhāna, dwells therein'; in the brahma-dwelling in such passages as: 'He dwells pervading one direction with a mind accompanied by loving-kindness'; and in the noble dwelling in such passages as: 'Then, Aggivessana, at the conclusion of that very talk, I steadied my mind internally on that very same preliminary sign of concentration, settled it, unified it, and concentrated it, by which I dwell for the most part.'

entries.pali: Avisesenā ti na visesena, vihārabhāvasāmaññenāti attho. Iriyāpatha…pe… vihāresū ti iriyāpathavihāro, dibbavihāro, brahmavihāro, ariyavihāroti etesu catūsu vihāresu. Samaṅgīparidīpana nti samaṅgībhāvaparidīpanaṃ. Eta nti ‘‘viharatī’’ti etaṃ padaṃ. Tathā hi taṃ ‘‘idhekacco gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī’’tiādīsu (saṃ. ni. 4.241) iriyāpathavihāre āgataṃ. ‘‘Yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī’’ti (dha. sa. 160; vibha. 624) ettha dibbavihāre. ‘‘So mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatī’’tiādīsu (dī. ni. 1.556; 3.308; ma. ni. 1.77; 2.309; 3.230) brahmavihāre. ‘‘So kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tassāyeva kathāya pariyosāne tasmiṃ eva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi, yena sudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmī’’tiādīsu (ma. ni. 1.387) ariyavihāre.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘无差别’者，谓非以差别，义为依于住之共同状态。‘威仪……于诸住中’者，谓于威仪住(iriyāpathavihāra)、天住(dibbavihāra)、梵住(brahmavihāra)、圣住(ariyavihāra)此四住中。‘具足显示’者，谓显示具足之状态。此者，即‘住’(viharati)一词。诚然，此词用于威仪住，如‘于此，某人与在家人杂居，同喜同忧’(相应部4.241)等。用于天住，如‘诸比丘，于其时，比丘离诸欲……入初禅而住’(法集论160；分别论624)。用于梵住，如‘彼以俱行慈心，遍满一方而住’(长部1.556等)等。用于圣住，如‘阿耆毗舍那(Aggivessana)，我于彼说法之末，即于先前之定相，于内安住、沉静、专一、等持我心，我依此而恒常安住’(中部1.387)等。
entries.english: Not in a particular way, but in the general sense of 'dwelling'—this is the meaning. The 'modes of deportment' (iriyāpatha)... in the 'dwellings' (vihāresu) refers to the dwelling of deportment, the divine dwelling, the brahma dwelling, and the noble dwelling—these four dwellings. The explanation of 'being well-equipped' (samaṅgīparidīpanaṃ) is the explanation of the state of being well-equipped. 'This' refers to the word 'dwells' (viharatī). For thus, it is found in the dwelling of deportment, as in: 'Here, a certain person dwells associating with householders, sharing their joys and sharing their sorrows,' etc. (SN 35.241). In the divine dwelling, as in: 'At the time, bhikkhus, when a bhikkhu, quite secluded from sensual pleasures... enters and dwells in the first jhāna' (Dhs 160; Vibh 262). In the brahma dwelling, as in: 'He dwells pervading one direction with a mind imbued with loving-kindness,' etc. (DN 13, etc.). In the noble dwelling, as in: 'So I, Aggivessana, at the conclusion of that very talk, steadied my mind internally, settled it, unified it, and concentrated it on that same preliminary sign of concentration, by which I always dwell,' etc. (MN 36).

entries.pali: ‘‘Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ, aggivessana, anekasatāya parisāya dhammaṃ desetā, apissu maṃ ekameko evaṃ maññati ‘mamevārabbha samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desetī’ti. Na kho panetaṃ, aggivessana, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Yāvadeva viññāpanatthāya tathāgato paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti. So kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tassāyeva kathāya pariyosāne tasmiṃyeva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi, ekodiṃ karomi, samādahāmi ‘yena sudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.387) –
entries.chinese_simplified: “阿耆毗舍那(Aggivessana)，我确实记得，我曾为数百人的集会说法，但他们中的每个人都认为：‘沙门乔达摩是为了我一个人说法。’阿耆毗舍那，不应如此看待。如来只是为了使人明了而为他人说法。阿耆毗舍那，我在说法结束时，就在先前那个禅定相中，令心安住、沉静、专注、统一，从而恒常安住于其中。”
entries.english: Moreover, Aggivessana, I recall teaching the Dhamma to assemblies of many hundreds, yet each individual thought, ‘The ascetic Gotama is teaching the Dhamma especially for me.’ But, Aggivessana, this should not be seen in such a way. The Tathāgata teaches the Dhamma to others merely for the purpose of conveying understanding. Then, Aggivessana, at the conclusion of that very talk, in that same original focus of concentration, I steady my mind internally, settle it, unify it, and concentrate it, by which I dwell constantly.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Appanāyopacārena, tamevātha samādahaṃ; Yogī ‘‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ, sikkhatī’’ti pakāsito.
entries.chinese_simplified: 以安止与近行，于彼令心安住；瑜伽行者被宣说为：‘他训练自己令心专注’。
entries.english: By means of absorption and access, then concentrating just that, the yogi is declared as one who trains thus: 'Concentrating the mind.'

path: 雷迪西亚多著作集 Leḍī-Sayāḍo-Gantha-Saṅgaho
entries.pali: Īādimhi-saddahi, saddahiṃsu. Tatra bhikkhavo samādahiṃsu dī. ni. 2.332 , samādahaṃsu vā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于不定过去时（ī等）：saddahi（他信解了）、saddahiṃsu（彼等信解了）。例如：Tatra bhikkhavo samādahiṃsu, samādahaṃsu vā（在那里，比丘们专注了，或作 samādahaṃsu）。
entries.english: In the aorist: saddahi, saddahiṃsu. There, the bhikkhus concentrated, or samādahaṃsu.
